purpose: Aggregate independently verified CPU/Jarvis epistemic-learning evidence without promoting intermediate passes into a full closed-loop autonomy claim.

ladder.name: reflection_to_query
ladder.claim: The bounded candidate can move from verified reflection evidence to a bounded documentation query in the tested holdout.

ladder.name: query_to_bounded_evidence
ladder.claim: The CPU oracle can return bounded, provenance-pinned evidence for a permitted query without exposing executable source.

ladder.name: evidence_to_telic_reevaluation
ladder.claim: Model-origin evidence reevaluation exists, but the recorded candidate gate is not full coverage of every reevaluation case.

ladder.name: recursive_epistemic_evidence
ladder.claim: The bounded telic evidence state machine consumed its prior cycle across two deterministic candidate-only cycles.

ladder.name: synchronized_cpu_gpu_exploration
ladder.claim: CPU and GPU proposal arms were paired with the same inputs while CPU truth remained invariant; raw GPU route convergence was not demonstrated.

ladder.name: adaptive_experiment_selection
ladder.claim: The isolated candidate authored bounded adaptive experiment choices over the retained route frontier in the tested holdout.

ladder.name: heldout_epistemic_route_generalization
ladder.claim: Factorized route-choice generalization passed on an unseen surface, but this is not full semantic-truth generalization.

ladder.name: closed_epistemic_learning_loop
ladder.claim: Specialized recursive and self-building surfaces exist, but one unified model-origin epistemic loop has not been independently proven end to end.
